info.title: Eigenpal API
info.description: Public REST API for inspecting automations, starting and monitoring runs, managing files, collecting human reviews, and running evaluations.

tags.name: Metadata
tags.description: Authenticate and inspect the current API context.

tags.name: Automations
tags.description: Inspect runnable workflow and agent automations, their versions, triggers, and source sync state.

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: Start, monitor, retry, review, and debug automation runs, including artifacts.

tags.name: Reviews
tags.description: Record human review verdicts, manage corrected outputs, and monitor review health.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Upload reusable files for later run or dataset use.

tags.name: Evaluation
tags.description: Manage datasets, examples, evaluators, experiment batches, evaluator scores, and run promotion workflows.

post.summary: Sync automation from latest Git release
post.description: Reconciles automation registry metadata and trigger projections from the latest Git source release. This operation is idempotent for unchanged source state: repeated calls against the same latest release leave the same automation registry state and may repeat the same warnings. Requires a Bearer API token for the organization and a user-backed API key. It does not publish source; it reads the already-published latest release manifest. Versioned targets are rejected with 400, missing organization/source/release/manifest state returns 404, invalid manifests return 400, and provider or persistence failures return 5xx.

parameters.name: id

schema.description: Automation target to sync, such as agents.invoice-agent or workflows.extract. Do not include a version; sync always uses the latest Git release.

parameters.description: Automation target to sync, such as agents.invoice-agent or workflows.extract. Do not include a version; sync always uses the latest Git release.

200.description: Automation metadata, latest release information, and non-fatal sync warnings.

type.description: Automation kind inferred from the source package path.

slug.description: Source package slug within agents/ or workflows/.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp for the reconciled automation row.

version.description: Latest released source package version that was synced.

tag.description: Git release tag read during sync.

commit.description: Git commit for the release tag.

warnings.description: Non-fatal source-state warnings, such as unsupported email alias domains.

PromoteRunRequest.description: Create or update a dataset example from the run input, actual output, and review corrections.

verdict.description: Reviewer verdict. Omit or send null for feedback without a ranking (nit). Defaults are applied client-side only; any verdict/status combination is accepted.

status.description: Review lifecycle. Defaults from verdict (`correct` → `closed`, otherwise `open`). Use `closed` or `wont_fix` to close an open review.

correctedOutput.description: Corrected JSON output for this run. Send `null` to clear a previously stored correction.

corrections.description: Field and file corrections. When present, replaces the entire correction set for this review. Omit to leave existing corrections unchanged.

RunReviewRequest.description: Create or replace review metadata for a run. Attribution fields (`reviewedBy`, `closedBy`, and their emails) are read-only and populated from the authenticated user or API key creator.

outputFileName.description: Name of an existing run output file to copy into corrected artifacts.

expectedName.description: Optional name for the copied corrected file. Defaults to the original output file name.
